title: Chit-Chat Cuttlefish
statement: This small, moon-pale cuttlefish drifts among sea-glass pebbles and a sunken, barnacled writing desk, rippling its skin with patterns that echo the colors of whoever stands at the glass. It always adds one small doodle of its own, often a spiral or a question mark. It is believed to be making conversation, and it seems delighted whenever anyone lingers long enough to answer.
